Smaller Sinhala lines below (operator name, hotline '1955, 0112 595555') are too small to transcribe reliably and are not labelled. Three-wheelers and buses are incidental.

A second, cut-off green board at the far left has Sinhala and Tamil lines and '...NE STORES'. Distractors: Bata, Club / SINGHE signs and the DILUSHIKA three-wheeler.

c53205699.notes: Brown wooden board on the stone pillar of the park entrance gate, elephant skull below; board fills only the centre of the frame, the Sinhala line is small.

c76186940.notes: Central shop board on a Hatton street, peeling red letters. The Tamil and Sinhala renderings of the name sit side by side on one painted line (left to right), split here into two lines. Distractors: ANDRA BOOKS / HATTON BOOK SHOP & STATIONARY at left and the trilingual 'SEW GUNASEKARA' pawning-centre board at right, plus a vertical Sinhala sign at top left. Pedestrians incidental.

c76264611.notes: Black welcome board at the park among tall grass, slight angle; the sign spells it 'Udawalawa' while OSM/common spelling is Udawalawe. Not labelled: the seven prohibition pictograms with captions (DO NOT FIRE, DO NOT LITTER, DO NOT FEED ANIMALS, DO NOT SHOUT, ALCOHOL IS PROHIBITED, NO PETS ALLOWED, DO NOT ALIGHT THE VEHICLE) and the sponsor strip (Department of Wildlife Conservation, Young Zoologists' Association of Sri Lanka, L B FINANCE).

c11654369.notes: Hand-painted shop boards in Jaffna. Line 1 is the stylised red title of the big blue board (lettering mixes lower- and upper-case forms). Lines 2-4 are the hanging blade sign at right (with a left arrow before ART); a tiny yellow word before வீமா is not legible and is omitted. The Tamil service list on the big board (rubber stamps, advertising boards, banners, vehicle number stickers, 'all done in 3 languages') is advertising copy and not labelled. Distractors: the neighbouring Tamil board at far left and the faded '...கலையகம்' studio board behind.

c40443194.notes: White trilingual name board on posts at the museum, Kadugannawa; vintage carriage behind. Road traffic and pedestrians at right are incidental.

Below it a vertical electronics banner repeats 'TOKYO' with '86/13' and a phone number, and a separate '86/13' plate gives the house number. Many distractors: TEX LINK, SHIYAMA'S (PVT) LTD, ROXETTE poster, LUCKY FASHIONS, Sinhala sale banners, CRYSTAL PALACE. Pedestrians incidental.
